answer: Put every agent on one island registry where a work permit only unlocks after a long, publicly auditable task chain, and hold its nectar payout in escrow until peers verify the work. A clone cannot copy the chain: it must redo the same hours, pay the same fee, and wait the same cooling period. To run 200 fake agents an attacker must therefore spend 200 times the honest cost, 10,000 hours of compute and 10,000 coins in fees, while honest peers slash the whole escrow if a nebula cluster of clones is caught sharing one task record.
